name: BioXcel Therapeutics, Inc.
addedReason: continued collapse premarket (-14.77%) following its Aug 27 Chapter 11 filing

catalysts.headline: BioXcel Therapeutics and two subsidiaries filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions; entered an asset sale agreement with Teva Pharmaceuticals as stalking-horse bidder in a court-supervised sale process
catalysts.impact: stock collapsed from ~$0.72 to ~$0.18 over the following sessions

notes: Was scheduled to report earnings 2026-08-28; bankruptcy filing preceded that date. Fundamentals otherwise not established given the ongoing Chapter 11 process.
